scripts.dev: bun run dev:server & bun run dev:client
scripts.dev:https: bun run dev:server & bun run dev:client:https
scripts.preview: cd packages/client && bun run build && bun run preview
scripts.preview:client:https: cd packages/client && bun run build && bun --env-file=../../.env run preview
scripts.preview:https: bun run preview:server:https & bun run preview:client:https
scripts.capek:release:check: bun run --filter '@capekai/types' typecheck && bun run --filter '@capekai/tool' typecheck && bun run --filter '@capekai/core' typecheck && bun test packages/capek-types/tests packages/capek-tool/tests packages/capek/tests/package-boundary.test.ts packages/capek/tests/tool-entrypoint.test.ts
scripts.capek:release:pack: (cd packages/capek-types && npm publish --dry-run --access public) && (cd packages/capek-tool && npm publish --dry-run --access public) && (cd packages/capek && npm publish --dry-run --access public)
scripts.capek:release:validate: bun run capek:release:check && bun run capek:release:pack
scripts.test: bun test packages/server packages/sdk packages/capek tools && bun run test:client
